body: Implements plan Phase C (§7). Builds on the T1 MVP package. Implement the advisory, fail-safe session hooks: session.created (checks runtime/git readiness and environment determinism, warns if not ready for fan-out) and session.ended (runs `gate-manifest verify` and warns only if the evidence chain is broken). Both must no-op cleanly when the repo is not ADLC-initialized. Acceptance: a unit test asserts each hook no-ops without .adlc/ and emits the expected advisory signal when the chain is broken. Read the plan as the contract.

edges.contract: plugins/adlc-opencode/ shared package (sequential single-session build, plan §6.7)

title: OpenCode integration Phase C: advisory session hooks (preflight + manifest audit)
